planets.name: K2-3 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-3 with a 10.1-day year, found in 2015.

text.card: K2-3 b was found in 2015 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-3. Its orbit and size follow Diamond-Lowe et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname DIAMOND_LOWE_ET_AL__2022): disc_year 2015, disc_facility K2, sy_pnum 3; pl_orbper 10.0546535, pl_radj 0.18538706, pl_bmassj 0.01607786

quotes.title: K2-3b
quotes.card: K2-3b, also known as EPIC 201367065 b, is an exoplanet orbiting the red dwarf K2-3 every 10 days.
quotes.introduction: It is the largest and most massive planet of the K2-3 system, with about 2.1 times the radius of Earth and about 5 times the mass.
